title: Spanish Chicken (Imported)
description: Authentic Spanish Chicken curated from TheMealDB culinary archives.
author: user_chef_roshan
instructions: Heat oven to 190C/170C fan/gas 5. Put all the ingredients into a large, wide ovenproof dish. Mix everything together with your hands and season.
Bake for 45 mins, stirring the onions after 20 mins, until the chicken is golden and the onions tender. Serve with rice.

title: North Indian Paneer Butter Masala
description: Tender cubes of Indian cottage cheese bathed in a silky, aromatic cashew and tomato gravy infused with green cardamom, kasuri methi, and butter.
author: user_chef_roshan
instructions: Melt butter in a heavy kadai or Dutch oven. Sauté onions and minced garlic until light golden.
Pour in fresh tomato puree and spices. Cook until oil begins to separate from the gravy edges (about 8 minutes).
Whisk in cashew paste and fresh cream to create a rich velvety texture.
Gently fold in fresh paneer cubes and simmer on low heat for 5 minutes so flavours infuse.
Crush dried fenugreek leaves (kasuri methi) between palms over the curry and finish with a knob of butter.

title: Artisan Avocado Toast with Poached Egg
description: Toasted country sourdough topped with coarse-smashed Hass avocado, Meyer lemon zest, microgreens, and a soft farm-fresh poached egg.
author: user_chef_roshan
instructions: Toast thick slices of artisan sourdough until golden and crisp.
In a shallow bowl, smash avocado with lemon juice, sea salt, and a dash of extra virgin olive oil.
Bring a small pot of water to a gentle simmer with a drop of vinegar. Create a gentle whirlpool and slip in cracked eggs.
Poach for 3 minutes until whites are firm and yolk is warm and runny.
Spread avocado generously over toast, crown each with a poached egg, sprinkle red chili flakes and flaky sea salt.

title: Crispy Skin Salmon & Quinoa Bowl
description: Pan-seared Atlantic salmon fillet with shatteringly crisp skin served over fluffy lemon quinoa, cucumber ribbons, and creamy avocado.
author: user_chef_roshan
instructions: Rinse quinoa and simmer in 2 cups of water with a pinch of salt for 15 minutes until tender and fluffy.
Pat salmon skin completely dry with paper towels; score lightly and season generously with salt.
Heat a cast iron skillet over medium-high heat with olive oil.
Place salmon skin-side down, pressing gently for 30 seconds. Cook for 5 minutes until skin is golden crisp.
Flip and finish cooking for 2-3 minutes. Plate quinoa in bowls, top with sliced avocado, cucumber ribbons, and crispy salmon.

title: Quick Pantry Fried Rice
description: A 15-minute weeknight wok classic using day-old jasmine rice, scrambled eggs, green onions, soy sauce, and aromatic sesame oil.
author: user_chef_roshan
instructions: Break up chilled jasmine rice with wet fingertips.
Heat a wok or large skillet on high heat with a tablespoon of oil.
Scramble eggs quickly and push to the side of the pan.
Add onions and minced garlic; stir-fry for 1 minute until fragrant.
Dump in cold rice and stir-fry continuously on high heat for 3-4 minutes.
Drizzle soy sauce and toasted sesame oil around the rim of the wok; toss vigorously and serve hot.

title: Tuscan Rigatoni with Basil Pomodoro
description: Al dente bronze-cut rigatoni tossed in a vibrant simmered San Marzano tomato pomodoro, golden garlic, fresh sweet basil, and aged parmigiano.
author: user_chef_roshan
instructions: Bring a large pot of heavily salted water to a rolling boil. Cook rigatoni until 1 minute shy of al dente.
In a wide heavy skillet, heat olive oil over medium-low heat. Add thinly sliced garlic and fry until fragrant and pale gold.
Add crushed tomatoes and a pinch of salt. Simmer gently for 12 minutes to thicken.
Toss cooked pasta directly into the sauce along with 1/4 cup starchy pasta water.
Stir vigorously to emulsify. Remove from heat, fold in hand-torn fresh basil and freshly grated parmesan.

title: Farmhouse Herb & Potato Omelette
description: Fluffy country-style eggs folded with pan-crisped russet potatoes, sweet sautéed onions, fresh chives, and melted gruyère cheese.
author: user_chef_roshan
instructions: Dice potatoes into 1/2-inch cubes and thinly slice onions.
Heat olive oil in a 10-inch skillet over medium heat. Fry potatoes until golden and tender (approx. 8 minutes).
Add sliced onions and cook for another 3 minutes until translucent.
Whisk eggs with salt and freshly cracked black pepper in a medium bowl.
Pour eggs gently over the hot potatoes and onions. Reduce heat to low.
Cook slowly until eggs are set around edges, sprinkle cheese on top, fold gently and serve warm.

title: Lemon Herb Chickpea & Avocado Power Bowl
description: A 15-minute nourishing plant-based powerhouse featuring crisp spiced chickpeas, creamy diced avocado, Persian cucumbers, and zesty tahini-lemon dressing.
author: user_chef_roshan
instructions: Rinse and thoroughly drain canned chickpeas; pat dry with paper towels.
Toss chickpeas in a bowl with 1 tbsp olive oil, sea salt, ground cumin, and smoked paprika.
Dice ripe avocado and Persian cucumbers, halve the sweet cherry tomatoes.
Whisk remaining olive oil with fresh lemon juice, tahini or mustard, salt and black pepper.
Assemble vegetables and spiced chickpeas in serving bowls, drizzle dressing, and enjoy fresh.
